identity_lock.silhouette: Large rounded navy beret, low-luminance ash-beige bob with outward side tufts, broad rounded head and face, compact four-head-tall body, long navy A-line dress, sturdy short legs, black Mary Jane shoes, thin tan cross-body strap, one compact satchel and one small rabbit remain unmistakable.
identity_lock.proportions: The approved front idle is authoritative: preserve head width, face width, approximately four-head-tall scale, compact torso, skirt length, sturdy thigh and calf volume, sock cylinders, shoe size, planted-foot spacing and full-body margins.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Pale rounded face, muted blue-gray eyes, fixed fringe and matte cool gray-beige hair; expression may move from brief surprise to narrowed wary annoyance without enlarging the eyes or face.
identity_lock.costume: Cream Peter Pan collar, orange neck bow, approved brass-button layout, full long sleeves, cream lace hem, cream socks, black Mary Jane shoes, fixed tan strap route, one compact tan satchel and one white rabbit with orange bow keep exact topology and scale.
identity_lock.rendering: Soft polished miniature anime game sprite, clean fine dark outlines, restrained warm cel shading, subdued hair highlights, fixed front orthographic camera, neutral lighting and no cast shadow.

action_contract.intent: A poke causes one restrained startle. She tightens inward, pulls the satchel and its rabbit close against her lower torso with her left arm, raises her right hand in a small controlled stop gesture, gives a sharp wary side-eye and tiny displeased mouth, then releases the guard and returns to neutral standing.
action_contract.startle_key: Both feet remain planted; shoulders lift slightly, elbows draw inward, chin retracts a fraction, eyes widen only subtly, right hand tightens near the strap and left hand contacts the outer satchel edge. No large jump or bend.
action_contract.guard_start_key: The left hand and forearm begin drawing the intact satchel and rabbit inward from the left hip toward the lower abdomen; right elbow bends and the right hand starts leaving the strap. Strap remains connected along its canonical route.
action_contract.guard_peak_key: The intact satchel and single rabbit are held close against the left-front lower torso by the left forearm without shape change; torso turns away only a few degrees; shoulders and knees remain compact; right forearm rises across the chest with a small palm-out stop silhouette.
action_contract.annoyed_hold_key: Protective left arm maintains bag contact while the right hand holds a restrained palm-out enough gesture near the sternum; eyelids narrow, one brow lowers slightly and the tiny mouth becomes a dry displeased slant. The expression is guarded and cutting, not furious.
action_contract.recovery_key: Right hand lowers toward the strap, left arm loosens, the intact bag and rabbit settle toward the canonical left hip, shoulders descend and the head returns toward center while one residual wary glance remains.
action_contract.locked_elements: Feet, foot spacing, baseline, root scale, hat, low-luminance hair, broad head and face, collar, orange bow, brass buttons, skirt length, leg thickness, shoes, strap route, satchel construction, single rabbit identity and camera remain fixed.
action_contract.allowed_motion: Small shoulder lift, elbow and hand movement, left forearm guarding contact, intact bag translation constrained by the strap, minimal rabbit secondary sway, torso yaw or lean no more than five degrees, tiny knee softening, gaze, eyelids, brows and a very small mouth change.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No step, jump, crouch, large recoil, shouting, clenched aggressive fist, weapon, impact marks, duplicated or detached rabbit, opened or deformed bag, broken strap, extra anatomy, body slimming, bright hair, enlarged face, camera zoom, crop, floor, shadow, text, effect, scenery or watermark.

key_pose_sources.strategy: Generate every key and later every transition as a separate complete full-character drawing from the canonical identity anchor and approved temporal neighbors. Never construct motion by moving, blending, warping or compositing parts.

K09 was then freshly redrawn from the original model sheet and approved front base, using the prior frame only as a low-resolution pose/contact guide and explicitly rejecting its surface texture. Automated QA includes a skirt-hem transition lock of plus or minus 3 pixels, hair luma drift of plus or minus 8, and a navy-region high-frequency texture proxy. The user accepted contact sheet v4 on 2026-07-29 and authorized production of the remaining direct continuous frames.

sequence_review.review_note: All 15 frames are independently drawn complete characters. Automated geometry, palette, motion, proportion, hair-luma, high-frequency texture and chroma-fringe checks pass. Godot integration and sprite-sheet packaging remain blocked until the user accepts this full sequence.

Frame 2 adds a restrained recoil and first clear hand contact while the bag remains unpulled.
Frame 3 closes the protective hand, begins the inward-up bag pull and releases the other hand from the strap into a restrained half-open response.
Frame 4 retains the approved established guard-start pose.
dynamic_revision_v6.generation_method: Frames 1-3 are separate fresh complete-character drawings generated from the immutable model sheet, canonical idle and approved temporal neighbors. Rejected candidates were discarded in full when head width, skirt hem, color or hand semantics failed. Post-processing is limited to chroma removal, one uniform whole-character downscale, one whole-layer integer root translation and the same v5 sequence-wide RGB mapping applied once to all frames. No local transform, manual proportion repair, part compositing, interpolation, morphing or deformation was used.
dynamic_revision_v6.palette_method: Apply the exact v5 RGB-only semantic color-compression function once to every v6 frame and the canonical authority; alpha is preserved byte-for-byte and no per-frame grade is used.
dynamic_revision_v6.qa_note: Uniform palette grade, generic sprite sequence QA, alpha identity, proportions, root alignment, palette consistency, texture, chroma fringe, established bag alignment and pre-action bag continuity all pass. Visual semantic review confirms a readable detect-contact-pull-guard chain with one continuous strap, one bag and one rabbit.
dynamic_revision_v6.gate_note: The user accepted the complete dynamic v6 sequence on 2026-07-30; it is ready for gated packaging and Godot integration.

threshold_notes.max_area_drift: The protective forearm and restrained stop hand widen the torso silhouette while body height, head size and feet remain fixed.

post_process.generation: Every motion frame is a separate complete-character built-in image-generation call using the canonical anchor and approved temporal neighbors.
post_process.forbidden: No cut-and-paste parts, local compositing, translated layers, optical flow, cross-fade, morphing, deformation or algorithmic interpolation.
post_process.background_removal: Use a perfectly flat #FF00FF source background and the installed chroma helper with border auto-key, tolerance 50, one-pixel edge contraction and 0.25 edge feather. A hard matte is retained because soft matting damaged pale skin and hair. Frame 10 keeps the contracted matte and raises only downsampled alpha values 1 through 8 to 9, preserving antialias coverage without restoring the rejected magenta fringe.
post_process.final_downsample: Uniformly normalize complete 1024x1024 drawings into fixed 512x512 cells with high-quality downsampling, preserving body scale, shoe center and the y=472 visible baseline corresponding to pivot (256,492).
